>>A<< POWER WINDOW MOTOR/WINDOW REGULATOR 
ASSEMBLY INSTALLATION
1. Power window motor and window regulator assembly 
installation procedure
CAUTION
Do not operate the power window motor until the glass 
installation is finished.
(1) Connect the power window motor to the body-side 
harness connector, and then turn on the ignition switch.
(2) Continue to pull the power window switch until the power 
window motor stops.
NOTE: Power window motor stops automatically and the 
limit switch incorporated in the power motor will be reset.
(3) Turn off the ignition switch, and then remove window 
motor from the body-side harness connector. 
(4) Align the power window motor drive shaft and the square 
hole in the drum by the following procedure, while using 
the guide and the opening in the motor housing as a 
reference for the installation position.
a. Align the square hole with the drive shaft by sliding the 
glass bracket (glass mounting section) or by turning 
the drum using a ratchet wrench [with a socket 
diameter of 12.7 mm (0.50 inches)].
b. Turn the drum to position the glass bracket as shown 
in the illustration. Support the drum and the guide with 
your hand while turning the drum, otherwise the wires 
may pull out of the drum.
c. If the wires pull out of the drum, re-insert them by 
following the drum and regulator wire installation 
procedure.
